sentences.en: We have run out of petrol, I don't know where to fill up the tank.
I'm afraid we have.
It's all my fault.

sentences.en: Why did you speak to me like this last night?

sentences.fa: اگر پدرت با ما همکاری می کرد پولدار می شد.
sentences.en: If your father cooperated with us, he would get rich.

sentences.fa: اگه پدرت با من همکاری کرده بود، پولدار می شد.
sentences.en: If your father had cooperated with me he would have gotten rich.

sentences.fa: اگه زودتر ازدواج کرده بودین دو‌تا بچه داشتین.
sentences.en: If you had gotten married earlier you would have had 2 children.
That's all your fault.

sentences.fa: اگه ساعت کوک کرده بودی خواب نمی موندی.
sentences.en: If you had set the alarm you wouldn't have over slept.

sentences.fa: اگه پولتو پس انداز كرده بودي به مشكل برنمي خوردي.
sentences.en: If you had saved your money, you wouldn't have encountered the problem.

sentences.fa: تو كه مي دوني من توي فشار و قرض بودم، چيكار مي كردم؟
sentences.en: You know I was in red, what would I do?

sentences.fa: اگه تو رفته بودي سراغ ته مونده پس اندازت اين خونه رو مي خريدي.
sentences.en: If you had broken into your nest egg, you would have bought this house.

sentences.fa: اگه مجلس اين لايحه رو تصويب كرده بود ، نون ما توي روغن بود.
sentences.en: If the parliament had approved of this bill, our bread would have been buttered on both sides.

sentences.fa: اگه همكار شما كلاه برداري نكرده بود ما لو داده نمي رفتيم.
sentences.en: If your colleague hadn't deceived in the bank, we wouldn't have been betrayed.

sentences.fa: اگر وكيل گرفته بودي اون كار مهاجرتتو درست مي كرد.
sentences.en: If you had hired a lawyer, he would have done your immigration.

sentences.fa: چيكار مي كردي اگه من به پدرت همه چيزو توضيح داده بودم؟
sentences.en: What would you have done if I had explained everything to your father?

conversation: A: I have been very stupid! I forgot to fill up the tank before we left!
B: Oh! You mean to say we have run out of petrol?
A: I'm afraid we have! And it's all my fault! If I hadn't forgotten to fill up the tank before we left, we wouldn't have run out of petrol! I wish I hadn't been so stupid!
